errors.evidence: The pie chart slices are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, starting from the top and moving clockwise, the sequence of percentages is 14.3%, 33.3%, approx 4.8%, and 47.6%, which is not sorted.
The statement claims the sectors are equal ('равни'), but they represent different percentages (47.6%, 33.3%, 14.3%, and approx. 4.8%) and are therefore not equal in size.
